methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Cabinet secretary: Southside county loses two economic development prospects due to uncertainty over data center taxes
signals.signal_reading: Southside losing data center projects due to tax policy uncertainty demonstrates how historically underserved regions remain vulnerable to policy volatility, unable to capture even infrastructure-level AI investment while NoVA compounds advantages.

signals.title: ODU and Google launch AI incubator to boost innovation in Hampton Roads - MSN
signals.signal_reading: ODU-Google AI incubator represents deep capability building in Hampton Roads, but its concentration in a single university-corporate partnership signals metro hub pattern rather than distributed regional capacity.

signals.title: AI pressure grows on Richmond's young workforce - Axios
signals.signal_reading: AI pressure on Richmond's young workforce indicates broad shallow adoption where workers must adapt to platform-delivered AI tools without necessarily developing deep technical capabilities or agency.

signals.title: EPA grant backs community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia - Virginia Tech News
signals.signal_reading: EPA-backed community-driven workforce training in Southwest Virginia shows potential for distributed capacity building through local institutions, but success depends on whether training creates deep fluency or surface-level credential collection.

signals.title: U.Va. pilots three new artificial intelligence literacy courses - The Cavalier Daily
signals.signal_reading: UVA's AI literacy courses signal institutional response to shallow-but-broad adoption needs, prioritizing consumption competency over creation capability across the student population rather than deep technical specialization.
